method: perf script --tid FOREGROUND_TIDS -i perf.data -F tid,period,ip,sym,symoff,dso; sum each sample's period once. Self means the first IP; inclusive means any recorded frame matches. Denominator includes every parsed foreground sample, not perf report's smaller filtered symbol-table total.
scope: Same captures and foreground TIDs as record-local-profiles.json. These include worker warmup and verification. Inclusive path cost is not a promised optimization gain.

symbol_resolution.vdso_offset_0x86c: Instruction immediately after RDTSCP at 0x869 in the internal time helper; caller attribution comes from sampled stacks.
